title: Thanks for the Food

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Now there's a culinary scent worth carrying. Got my stomach growling louder than the voices these wires used to carry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now there's a culinary scent worth carrying. Got my stomach growling louder than the voices these wires used to carry.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Well, well, got something for me? Half thought you were gonna take those Lims and run. Wouldn't be surprised. Probably woulda done it myself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, well, got something for me? Half thought you were gonna take those Lims and run. Wouldn't be surprised. Probably woulda done it myself.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Look at that goodness. See, all it takes is a little food and moods change, exhaustion lifts and work goes on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look at that goodness. See, all it takes is a little food and moods change, exhaustion lifts and work goes on.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Like is a strong word. Puts food on the table or, you know, in the container you just gave me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like is a strong word. Puts food on the table or, you know, in the container you just gave me.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: An endless amount. No, it's not really. I got a few more relays to install but I'm short one. Damn thing broke during transport.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: An endless amount. No, it's not really. I got a few more relays to install but I'm short one. Damn thing broke during transport.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: It's what I get for using a discount delivery service.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's what I get for using a discount delivery service.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Ha. Like it actually matters. But that's a convo for another time. Right now I gotta figure out how to get this done with the mess they left me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha. Like it actually matters. But that's a convo for another time. Right now I gotta figure out how to get this done with the mess they left me.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Unfortunately, there are two major problems with that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unfortunately, there are two major problems with that.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: I'm down to the last two relays and come to find out one's busted worse than a self-driving HOVA powered with a narcissistic suicidal AI.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm down to the last two relays and come to find out one's busted worse than a self-driving HOVA powered with a narcissistic suicidal AI.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Don't need a night of "Level Up!" to figure out things are whacked right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't need a night of "Level Up!" to figure out things are whacked right now.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: There in lies the major issue: you can't get these right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There in lies the major issue: you can't get these right now.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Well I saw it on the news feeds so they're reporting it. Doesn't mean it's actually happening just that it's being reported.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I saw it on the news feeds so they're reporting it. Doesn't mean it's actually happening just that it's being reported.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Ha! I could go home. Then again, if I did, my door'd be gettin' knocked on and I'd be dragged right back out here to finish the gig. Only, I wouldn't be getting paid anymore.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha! I could go home. Then again, if I did, my door'd be gettin' knocked on and I'd be dragged right back out here to finish the gig. Only, I wouldn't be getting paid anymore.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Legal? Did you just fall off the habanero HOVA? The employers make the law, we just sign at the bottom.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Legal? Did you just fall off the habanero HOVA? The employers make the law, we just sign at the bottom.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Gee, thank you for that crack advice. You should host a talk show: Things you should and shouldn't do this side of the obvious.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gee, thank you for that crack advice. You should host a talk show: Things you should and shouldn't do this side of the obvious.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Yeah. Bone is a natural conductor. Should see some of the shamans in the wastes when they start ringing bowls with bleached femurs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. Bone is a natural conductor. Should see some of the shamans in the wastes when they start ringing bowls with bleached femurs.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: This entire conversation is kind of a mouthful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This entire conversation is kind of a mouthful.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: I'm going to try and lay the rest of these cables while you go and see my girl Harmony. She can usually get her hands on anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm going to try and lay the rest of these cables while you go and see my girl Harmony. She can usually get her hands on anything.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: You wanted something to do!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You wanted something to do!

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Won't know until you ask!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Won't know until you ask!

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: First, not supposed to leave an active job site, what with all the bullshit going on with lockdowns and unity zones and people stabbing each other and junk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: First, not supposed to leave an active job site, what with all the bullshit going on with lockdowns and unity zones and people stabbing each other and junk.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: They're version 2.1 and only a limited number were produced. See this diode? It's actually a bone needle meant to attract audio waves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They're version 2.1 and only a limited number were produced. See this diode? It's actually a bone needle meant to attract audio waves.
